title.zh: 21 天生产学习验收第 15 天

purpose.en: Publish the non-secret bilingual administrator report for the September 4 real-Chrome four-language learning acceptance run and preserve its unresolved administrator-ledger boundary.
purpose.zh: 发布 9 月 4 日真实 Chrome 四语学习验收的非私密双语管理员报告，并保留尚未解决的管理员账本复核边界。

en: Record Course, Sprint, SmartCard, Challenge, Everyday Speaking, Score History, Rankings, Dashboard, Home, and Community evidence for English, Japanese, Spanish, and Italian.

Record exact persisted Sprint scores, planned minimum active-learning durations, deep-focus skills, no-microphone behavior, normal UI-created learning records, and the blocked administrator-only ledger review.
zh: 记录英语、日语、西班牙语和意大利语的课程、速成、智慧卡、挑战、生活口语、成绩、排行、用户面板、首页与社区证据。
记录精确持久化 Sprint 分数、计划最低有效学习时长、深度技能、无麦克风行为、正常 UI 学习记录及受阻的管理员账本复核。

en: Administrator Project report for 2026-09-04 and the exact release record; no learning runtime, route, schema, provider, payment, referral, certificate, or entitlement behavior changes.
zh: 影响 2026-09-04 管理员 Project 报告及精确发布记录；不修改学习运行逻辑、路由、架构、服务商、支付、推荐、证书或权益行为。

en: Append one bilingual day-15 QA report derived from real signed-in production evidence.
Disclose the missing Cloudflare administrator read-only credential and one non-reproduced Sprint navigation error without weakening or fabricating acceptance evidence.
zh: 追加一份来自真实登录生产证据的双语第 15 天 QA 报告。
披露缺少 Cloudflare 管理员只读凭据及一次未再次复现的 Sprint 导航错误，不削弱或虚构验收证据。

en: Require the full repository release gate, shared site policy gates, exact deployment, production Project report verification, and sensitive-data checks.
Real Chrome evidence must retain the Chinese interface, four language targets, Repeat After Me off, no microphone permission, legitimate server scores, and persisted Score History.
zh: 要求完整仓库发布门禁、共享站点策略门禁、精确部署、生产 Project 报告核对及敏感数据检查。
真实 Chrome 证据必须保持中文界面、四个目标语言、跟读关闭、不请求麦克风权限、合法服务器分数及持久化成绩记录。

en: Administrator read-only confirmation that payment, referral, and certificate ledgers remained unchanged is blocked until the existing Cloudflare credential is available; no runtime defect fix is included.
zh: 支付、推荐与证书账本未变的管理员只读确认在现有 Cloudflare 凭据可用前保持受阻；本次不包含运行缺陷修复。

en: Preserve SmartLingo branding, all learning behavior and persisted activity, Clerk, RealtimeKit, SmartPay5, referral, certificate, header, footer, and independent infrastructure boundaries.
zh: 保留 SmartLingo 品牌、全部学习行为与持久化活动、Clerk、RealtimeKit、SmartPay5、推荐、证书、页眉页脚及独立基础设施边界。

rollback.en: No data migration is included; roll back only the report commit if its presentation regresses, without altering legitimate learning records.
rollback.zh: 不包含数据迁移；如报告展示异常，仅回滚报告提交，不得改写合法学习记录。
